proves.claim: with composeLanding true, verify never offers a submitted slice and offers its submitted parent only once every slice child is submitted.

store.io-board-next.compose-landing-hold.why: Without this test, a regression where with composeLanding true, verify never offers a submitted slice and offers its submitted parent only once every slice child is submitted would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: with composeLanding false or unset, a submitted slice is offered for review exactly as before.

store.io-board-next.compose-landing-off-.why: Without this test, a regression where with composeLanding false or unset, a submitted slice is offered for review exactly as before would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: reviewOffer given who.composeLanding true never returns a submitted slice.

store.io-board-next.compose-landing-revi.why: Without this test, a regression where reviewOffer given who.composeLanding true never returns a submitted slice would pass unnoticed.
